## What's new

### Queues and bulk actions
- Select several downloads (or all of them) and start, pause, move to a queue or remove them together.
- Create your own queues from the sidebar; each can be started and stopped on its own.
- "Clear completed" removes finished downloads from the list and keeps the files on disk.

### Faster downloads
- Large files download in up to 8 parts at once by default (up to 32 in Settings).
- When one part finishes, its connection takes over half of the slowest remaining part.
- If a server allows fewer connections, pixidl uses fewer instead of failing.
- The details panel shows a live map of the parts and active connections.

### Updates
- New Updates page: checks GitHub for new versions, downloads the installer, verifies its SHA-256 and installs it.
- Optional daily automatic check; pre-releases only if you turn them on.

### Browser extension 2.1
- Browser downloads go to pixidl by default. The browser keeps its own copy if pixidl is not running, gives an error or does not answer in time.
- Hold Alt while clicking a link to let the browser download it.
- More reliable selection button, also in tabs that were open before the extension was installed or updated.

### Languages
- Added Kurdish (Sorani and Kurmanji), Arabic, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian and Simplified Chinese.

## تازه‌ها
- صف‌ها، انتخاب چندتایی و عملیات گروهی؛ پاک‌کردن دانلودهای تکمیل‌شده
- دانلود چندبخشی سریع‌تر (تا ۸ اتصال به‌صورت پیش‌فرض) با نقشهٔ زندهٔ بخش‌ها
- صفحهٔ به‌روزرسانی: بررسی، دانلود، تأیید SHA-256 و نصب نسخهٔ جدید از GitHub
- افزونهٔ مرورگر ۲٫۱: ارسال خودکار دانلودهای مرورگر به pixidl
- زبان‌های جدید: کردی (سورانی و کرمانجی)، عربی، ترکی، آلمانی، فرانسوی، اسپانیایی، پرتغالی، روسی و چینی

## Install
Download `pixidl_1.1.0_x64-setup.exe` below. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the checksum of every file. Users of 1.0.0 need to install this version by hand once; from 1.1.0 on, updates can be installed from the app.
